copy.hero_headline: Pictures you will still want on the wall in ten years
copy.hero_sub: A daylight studio on Brock Street, and work on location.
about: A room with north-facing windows, a paper backdrop and lights for when the weather does not cooperate. Portraits, families and the work small businesses need for their own pages.
Sessions are unhurried. Nobody photographs well in the first ten minutes, so the first ten minutes are not the ones that count.

faq.a: Tuesday to Saturday. Thursday runs until eight for people who work days.

faq.q: Do you shoot outside the studio?
faq.a: Yes — outdoors, at home, or at a venue, depending on what the pictures are for.

faq.q: How long is a portrait session?
faq.a: About an hour in the studio, which is longer than the good frames need.
